about: A cat seen roughly from the side. f_ = the front leg nearest to us, h_ = the hind leg nearest to us, ff_ and hf_ = the far legs (optional).

help.crown: top of the head between the ears
help.nape: back of the skull, where the neck starts
help.chest: bottom of the ribcage, just behind the front legs
help.f_shoulder: front leg: shoulder joint, at the front of the chest
help.f_wrist: wrist, the joint that looks like a knee
help.h_knee: knee, at the front of the thigh
help.h_hock: hock, the heel that sticks out backward

options.airborne: true if the cat is mid-jump (skips the balance check)
options.planted: optional list of the paws that are on the ground in this drawing, for example ["f_paw", "hf_paw"]. Default: every paw near the lowest one.
